automated.why: Community files explain use, contribution and maintenance.
automated.message: Every floor file, issue form and check workflow is present and non-empty.

automated.why: A host can identify a skill from its metadata.
automated.message: Each SKILL.md has a valid name, description and size.

automated.why: People can find the project, license and support route.
automated.message: Homepage, repository, bugs and license fields are present.

automated.why: A default read token limits a compromised step.
automated.message: Every workflow declares read-only or empty default permissions.

automated.why: A commit pin identifies the exact action code.
automated.message: Every remote action uses forty hex characters and a version comment.

automated.why: Later commands need only their explicit permissions.
automated.message: Each checkout step sets persist-credentials: false.

automated.why: Untrusted event text must not become shell code.
automated.message: No event, head_ref or input interpolation appears in run values or github-script bodies.

automated.why: Local usernames are private environment details.
automated.message: Home paths use placeholder usernames in contents and filenames.

automated.why: A contact address should be an explicit public choice.
automated.message: Email addresses are in the allowlist or a standard example or noreply domain.

automated.why: A public artifact must not carry access credentials.
automated.message: Token-shaped strings and private key headers are absent.
